description: Build a consolidated cross-source dossier for a company in one call: SEC registration and identifiers (EDGAR), environmental footprint and regulated facilities (EPA ECHO), and sanctions/denied-party screening (OFAC/UN/EU/BIS) with a confidence score. Returns a per-source summary plus top records. This is a single AI-native lookup across data that otherwise lives in separate silos. Matches are name-based; verify identity before relying on any link.

limit.description: Max records to surface per source (default 5, max 15).

name.description: Company / organization name, e.g. 'Chevron Corporation', 'Acme Trucking LLC'.

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state to disambiguate location-based sources (e.g. 'TX').

name: entity_dossier
